title: UniversalX CB
description:
A power focused modpack packed with QOL features, bosses, and armor and weapons to battle them. While also maintaining 100+ FPS 
(new version coming soon)
body:
## UniversalX CB – Enhanced Progression, Power, and Exploration

This custom Minecraft modpack is built to **massively** upgrade the vanilla experience through powerful QOL features, deep progression, and high intensity combat.

_before you read: I recomend using Modrinth App since its way faster to instal stuff and play directly from there yk_

_(Install: [ProjectJJK](https://modrinth.com/mod/projectjjk/version/1.2.0-1.21.1-fabric-beta) for the best experiance.) [Specter](https://github.com/hadences/SpecterReleases/releases/tag/v0.1.6) BOTH if you want to use projectJJk_

The pack includes core QOL improvements such as hammers(to help mine faster), tree VeinMine for faster resource gathering, advanced tools and armor sets, and modern traversal options including planes and rapid mobility mods to move across the world efficiently. More gringing, build, and explore faster.

_(Install [Big Globe](https://modrinth.com/mod/big-globe) | [Biomes O' Plenty](https://modrinth.com/mod/biomes-o-plenty) | [Tectonic](https://modrinth.com/datapack/tectonic) for overworld terrain gen. and [Incendium](https://modrinth.com/datapack/incendium) for nether.) - NOTE: This will have affect on your pc, so I recomend following this tutorial -> [Chunky Tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=anNbAvQ21Z4) [credit to: 
KasaiSora] (NOT SPONSORED)_

Progression is expanded with Mythic Metals, introducing new ores, alloys, tools, and late-game gear, while (again, i highly recommend it)Project JJK adds anime inspired abilities, combat systems, and unique gameplay mechanics that dramatically change how you fight and progress.

(Use the mods listed above for world gen :D) World exploration is completely refreshed through custom terrain generation mods and datapacks, creating more immersive, varied, and visually striking landscapes. The world feels larger, more dangerous, and more rewarding to explore.

**NOTE: IF YOU ARE A RICH KID WITH NASA PC INSTALL: [JJThunderToTheMax](https://modrinth.com/datapack/jjthunder-to-the-max) for overworld & [JJThunder Hell Is Fire](https://modrinth.com/datapack/jjthunder-hell-is-fire)**

(Go to the bottom I have something insane for you to watch. Source: **TRUST ME BRO**) Combat is taken to the next level with custom bosses that can be configured and scaled, along with powerful custom weapons, tools, and armor sets designed for endgame dominance. Enchanting is fully uncapped no limits on enchantment levels(Protection XVIISKIBIDI), allowing for truly overpowered builds and experimentation & to help beat bosses. (some sick info for you: you can set boss's health to any amount.. and edit their damage/defence stats...)

This modpack is ideal for players who want freedom, power, and progression without artificial limits, whether you’re building massive projects, grinding endgame gear, or fighting god-tier bosses.
